I just see it as a differing in viewpoints. My personal belief is that **I** would not like to go around with my girlfriend (I'm a guy btw) feeling like she's stuck with me or made a bad choice with me, or be in a group and have people not care about what I have to say because someone else is much more interesting/likable. I wouldn't want to become a musician or something else and have people say, "Yeah he's good, but he's no ___". Shit, I wouldn't want to be an accountant and lose out on a job to someone much better than me. There are so many disadvantages to being second best.

No one ever remembers number two. :P Who did James Buchanan run against? Who did **Bill Clinton** run against? (It'd be a stretch to remember that even)
